method: Each reserved INFO and FORMAT table row was matched to a canonical ledger requirement using the exact VCFv4.5 source line locator, not key text alone. This disambiguates repeated keys such as AD, ADF, ADR, DP and MQ that occur in both namespaces. Number and Type title comparisons are reported separately; the source-line mapping is the primary traceability key.

mappings.ledger_title: VCFv4.5 reserved INFO key AA: Number=1, Type=String
mappings.semantic_note: Reserved optional INFO definition; row supplies the field's declared Number, Type and meaning, but does not require the field to occur in every record.

mappings.table_description: Allele count in genotypes, for each ALT allele, in the same order as listed
mappings.ledger_title: VCFv4.5 reserved INFO key AC: Number=A, Type=Integer
mappings.semantic_note: Number=A binds one value per ALT allele in ALT order; this is not one value per record.

interpretation: All 84 reserved INFO/FORMAT table rows have exactly one canonical ledger requirement mapped by exact source line.
Ten repeated key names have multiple candidates under key-text matching alone; exact namespace and source-line matching resolves all ten.
This establishes table-row-to-ledger traceability only. It does not establish complete field-specific prose, footnote, exception, example, or cross-reference reconciliation.
The 84 row mappings remain author-reviewed and require independent standards review. No implementation or test evidence is asserted.
